profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer @ S&P Global | Python, Software Infrastructure
profile.summary: With over six years of experience, currently contributing as an Associate Software Engineer at S&P Global, focusing on software infrastructure, Python development, and data management. Known for enabling robust, scalable solutions while leveraging AI-focused certifications to enhance organizational capabilities. Passionate about driving innovation through collaborative efforts and aligning technical expertise with S&P Global's mission to provide essential insights and data to empower decision-making. Dedicated to delivering impactful results with a balance of technical proficiency and teamwork.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Skills: Enterprise Data Management · System Administration · Software Infrastructure · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · EDM

positions.title: Research Analyst
positions.description:
Amalgamate data using various Excel functions and features such as vlookup, pivot tables, and custom VBA functions in order to present coherent data and analysis to clients and colleagues.
Research and investigate index components on a daily basis to guarantee financial strength and liquidity requirements are met.
Decide how to implement corporate actions in a manner that ensures liquidity, reduces tracking error, and reduces index turnover.
Design audits and processes to reduce user error and increase work flow. 
Coordinate with data vendors to insure the accuracy, reliability, and accessibility of Dow Jones Indexes data across vendor platforms.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description:
Accountable for reviewing data within Dow Jones' databases to ensure quality and accuracy.
 Managed external client and internal (The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch) fact checking and data requests.
Performed classification research for fixed income instruments and equities.
Conducted equity research via SEC filings, FactSet, Bloomberg, and Thompson Reuters terminals.  
Beta tested and reviewed newly developed applications related to the creation and calculation of equity indexes.
